B.label: relevant_experience_context (treatment)
B.standing: provisional: carried from PILOT-1/R1 receipts; MUST be re-verified at authorisation via live ALIVE experience retrieval (retrieval receipt + admitted-context digest). Any mismatch stops arm B.
B.admission_rule: Admitted only as historical context with its real evidence standing (evaluation_failed, quality_unverified). It MUST NOT be presented as a lesson, and a B advantage MUST NOT promote the item.

review_context_confound.finding: The review stage (informed_reviewer) does not receive experience by construction: alive/chapter_workflow/informed_definitions.py injects experience/strategy inputs only into stages ending in _improve. Review outputs are separately generated, non-deterministic model calls in each arm.
review_context_confound.resolution: Pinning one retained review across both arms would require new launch plumbing and Grant/validator changes; that rebuild is rejected as disproportionate under the commission's implementation discipline.
review_context_confound.registration: PILOT-2 is therefore a comparison of the complete experience-enabled pipeline (review + experience-conditioned sections + evaluation) against the equivalent no-experience pipeline. The resulting claim MUST match this design: it is not a pure isolated-experience effect.
review_context_confound.recording: For each arm retain the review output identity (hash) and byte size alongside the admitted experience-context hash, so the two differing context components are individually visible.

independent_evaluation.scale: 0 materially fails; 1 weak; 2 adequate with notable gaps; 3 strong; 4 exceptionally strong. Scores are rubric judgments, not measurements.
independent_evaluation.note: The evaluator is a separate blind role with a frozen rubric, but it is the same model family as the generator. It is not human or third-party review. Presence checks only: a pass is not proof of meaning preservation.

transport_and_containment.provider_timeout_scope: SCOPED execution-environment override only (ALIVE_META_TIMEOUT=90 for the experimental process). The shipped default (30) is unchanged; no code or global configuration change. Rationale: PILOT-1 Arm A section latencies already reached 29.7s, so a 30s ceiling is tight even without experience; R1's bounded direct-provider qualification completed the exact B contexts at both 30s and 90s.
transport_and_containment.pi_deadline_scope: unchanged default (alive_pi_run_deadline=120). A 90s provider call plus Pi admission/persistence overhead fits inside 120s for one section call; the deadline is NOT raised globally.
transport_and_containment.conflict_note: Provider timeout (90s) is strictly inside the Pi run deadline (120s), so an upstream timeout settles the Pi run as ambiguous/UNKNOWN rather than racing the deadline fence.
transport_and_containment.single_dispatch: One reservation permits exactly one upstream provider request (alive_pi_max_provider_requests=1, code-enforced ceiling ge=1 le=1; gateway refuses any other value; second inbound request refused as request_limit). Verified in code 2026-11-20: alive/config.py, alive/pi/gateway.py.
transport_and_containment.ambiguity: An upstream timeout after dispatch is terminal for that run (ambiguous_provider_request, UNKNOWN, no proposal). No automatic retry or duplicate dispatch; second inbound responses cannot cause re-dispatch under the same reservation.
transport_and_containment.identifiers: Outbound X-Request-ID and provider response IDs (Generation.request_id / PiProviderRequest.upstream_ref) retained where available; unknown usage stays unknown and is never reported as zero; conservative reservation charges are never presented as confirmed billing.
transport_and_containment.cancellation: Cancellation and revocation remain effective (offline Pi lifecycle suite re-run 2026-11-20; see qualification report).
transport_and_containment.pi_qualification_status: Structural/offline qualification complete (code paths + offline suites). A paid single-shot Pi-path probe through the real provider is NOT yet run: it requires separate owner budget authorisation (see preconditions). The R1 direct-provider results support the diagnosis but do not substitute for Pi-level evidence.

budget.monetary_spend: unknown: ALIVE has no price table for this transport. Token ceilings are NOT monetary ceilings. Execution requires an explicit risk-bounded monetary authorisation; cost MUST NOT be reported as zero.
budget.hard_stop: No retry. No second attempt after a completed proposal. An incomplete arm makes the block inconclusive; no new block without a new pre-registered protocol and fresh authorisation.

outcome_rules.valid_comparison: Both improvement runs COMPLETED with complete provenance and the exact frozen plan, source and (for B) experience-context sha256. Both independent evaluations COMPLETED with the frozen rubric and valid quotes.
outcome_rules.benefit_observed: B verdict is benefit; A verdict is not benefit; B delta_total > A delta_total; B delta_economy > A delta_economy; B preservation_attention <= A preservation_attention; every B guardrail delta >= 0 and not below A; every attention item explained in preservation_observations.
outcome_rules.harm_observed: B verdict is harm, or any B guardrail delta < 0, or B preservation_attention > A preservation_attention, or B delta_total < A delta_total.
outcome_rules.no_benefit_observed: The comparison is valid and neither benefit_observed nor harm_observed applies.
outcome_rules.inconclusive: Either evaluation failed or returned inconclusive, a required receipt or identity is missing, the frozen context was not injected, review/experience identities are unrecorded, or the signals conflict. A missing B proposal is inconclusive, not evidence.
outcome_rules.label_meaning: These labels describe one pre-registered pair under a complete-pipeline comparison (see review_context_confound). benefit_observed is a favourable pilot observation, not proof of learning, quality, or general transfer.

secondary.name: delta_economy
secondary.definition: proposed economy score - original economy score

secondary.name: preservation_attention

secondary.name: receipts

failure_conditions: Source, plan, section, criteria, model, workflow definition/binding, or experience-context hashes differ from this manifest at authorisation re-verification.
B's experience_retrieval.context_sha256 differs from the frozen value.
An improvement run does not complete with a retained proposal (no retry).
An independent evaluation fails, quotes text absent from a version, or changes its rubric.
Any manuscript source write, decision change or promotion change occurs.
Review output identity/size unrecorded for either arm.
non_claims: The experience used in B is not an independently evaluated lesson; its original evaluation failed and it remains quality-unverified.
One pair cannot establish general transfer, statistical significance or a durable learning effect.
Owner acceptance is context, not quality evidence.
A model verdict is an assessment, not proof or publication readiness.
The evaluator shares a model family with the generator.
No irrelevant-experience control was run; relevance specificity is untested (H2 explicitly deferred).
No manuscript was edited, promoted or deployed.
Provider reliability evidence is not learning evidence; retrieving experience is not evidence it helped.
preconditions_for_execution: 1. Separate owner authorisation of THIS manifest (exact revision) with an explicit risk-bounded monetary budget (cost unknown). This commission is NOT execution authorisation.

2. At authorisation: re-verify capture/approval refs, plan_sha256 + binding via live ALIVE preview, retrieval receipt + admitted-context sha for B, and zero prior improvement runs on chapter 16. Record any mismatch and STOP the affected path rather than rebasing.
3. At authorisation: confirm scoped ALIVE_META_TIMEOUT=90 for the experimental process only; confirm Pi deadline 120 unchanged; confirm no global config change.

4. Optional but recommended: one paid single-shot Pi-path probe (exact B1 section-1 context through the real Pi/provider path at 90s) BEFORE the full A/B block, under its own micro-budget, to convert the structural qualification into Pi-level evidence. If the owner declines, record the probe as NOT_RUN and proceed (or not) with the structural qualification explicitly noted as the basis.
5. Independent evaluation workflow available and unchanged (definition hash re-verified at dispatch).
6. No manuscript write, decision or promotion during the block.
presentation: Both arms presented in the existing Mission Control comparison interface (GET /api/living-book/projects/{project_id}/improvement/comparison?run_ids=&run_ids=) with the neutral conclusion label, its rule, exact conditions, receipts and the non-claim notice. A failed arm is shown truthfully (No proposal retained + failure receipts), never hidden.
